import sys
data = b'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n'
data += b'Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED\n'

data += b'\n'
data += b'YWJjZGVmZ2hpamtsbW5vcA==\n'
data += b'-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n'
sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
" > /tmp/test4.pem && /tmp/read_pem_fuzz /tmp/test4.pem 2>&1; echo "Exit: $?"
